items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did a piece called Inding – I-n-d-i-n-g – with – the date that has Elmo on it.

ctx.x: I want to go into that a little bit when we talk about the Lower East Side stuff. But are there any of these sessions – Prestige sessions – that you’re particularly proud of? Or that you’d like to talk about or bring anything out about?

By this time I can’t even – they’re very vague to me. I can’t even remember. I know that there were a couple of experimental things that I did that interest me. I did a piece called Inding – I-n-d-i-n-g – with – the date that has Elmo on it. That was a whole different concept of my writing, and it was getting ready to move some other place in 1957. But other than that, it’s just a bunch of stuff all rolled together. I can remember the Blue Note dates clearer.
How about the John Jenkins date?
